post.summary: Move the order. IN_PROGRESS->DELIVERED (assigned coder, all milestones approved), DELIVERED->ACCEPTED|IN_PROGRESS (customer; ACCEPTED hands the repo over), IN_PROGRESS|DELIVERED->DISPUTED (customer, reason required; freezes the escrow still held). DRAFT->FUNDED (escrow holds the price), FUNDED->DISPATCHED (wave sent) and DISPATCHED->IN_PROGRESS (POST /v1/offers/{id}/accept) are taken by the server.
